events.verdict: Kuminga (GSW) jumps from point A to point B when body contact occurs. He also comes across Plumlee's (PHX) arm in order to get to the ball, which affects his ability to finish the dunk attempt.
Schroder (GSW) establishes himself in Beal's (PHX) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs while setting the screen.
Dunn (PHX) contests Wiggins' (GSW) jump shot attempt and gets to ball height to cleanly block the ball.
Schroder (GSW) reaches in and there is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms the degree of contact as Durant (PHX) loses control of the ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Durant (PHX) loses possession of the ball while dribbling, and is last to make contact with the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to GSW.
Durant (PHX) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Beal (PHX) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Wiggins (GSW) delivers contact to Durant (PHX), dislodging him from his rebounding position, and affecting his ability to gain possession of the ball.
Durant's (PHX) arm is extended forward and down when contact occurs with Kuminga's (GSW) shooting arm during his layup attempt.
Green (GSW) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Beal (PHX) gets tangled up with Schroder (GSW) without grabbing or pulling his arm as marginal contact occurs when they both go to the floor during the loose ball.
Jackson-Davis (GSW) makes marginal contact as he places a hand to Beal's (PHX) arm then immediately removes it away when Beal enters his upward shooting during his driving shot attempt.
Plumlee (PHX) has resting hands on Schroder (GSW), which he releases when marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Okogie (PHX) commits a take foul on Kuminga (GSW).
Schroder (GSW) legally contests Beal's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
